examples.question: 2001 年 2 月的门店退货率是多少？口径：门店退货率（%）= 期间内售出的门店销售行所对应的退货金额（sr_return_amt）之和 ÷ 这些销售行的净支付额（ss_net_paid）之和 × 100；按销售日期归属期间，退货按小票号和商品与销售行对应，每笔退货只计一次。保留两位小数。
examples.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt)
   FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
   JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
   WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 2)
  /
  (SELECT SUM(ss.ss_net_paid)
   FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
   WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 2)
  * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
